title: Practice: Adjectives and possessives, plural; surnames

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «возражений»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He doesn't agree with the new reforms.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «реформами»: instrumental plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Tom loves soapboxing about the hot button issue of the day.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «темы»: accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Don't pay any attention to her whims.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «капризы»: accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
The adjective agrees with «явления»: accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Cockfighting is banned in many countries.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «странах»: prepositional plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: В ___ (девяностый) годы Интернет называли ещё "информационным суперхайвеем".
exercises.prompt: The Internet was also called the information superhighway in the 1990s.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «годы»: accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: For some expressions, it's not so easy to find an appropriate translation.
exercises.ru: К ___ фразеологизмам не так-то просто подобрать годный перевод.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «фразеологизмам»: dative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Пассажиры набиты в ___ (городской) автобусы как сардины в банку.
exercises.prompt: Passengers are packed in like sardines on city buses.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «автобусы»: accusative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Sharks are killed for their fins.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «плавников»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Пилоты поддерживают связь с ___ (аэропортовый) службами по радио.
exercises.prompt: Pilots communicate with airport services by radio.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «службами»: instrumental plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He really cares for his parents.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «родителях»: prepositional plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Земельная реформа привела к ___ (больший) переменам в жизни людей.
exercises.prompt: Land reform caused a great change in the lives of the people.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «переменам»: dative plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
The adjective agrees with «головах»: prepositional plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
